tools.name: ask_this_brief
tools.description: Ask a question about the entitled Brief (5m current day for guests; Public preview only until follow; archive if canReadArchive). Returns a grounded answer + citations, then highlights matching stories/sources. Not a Brief digest (use get_latest_brief). No web search, no new Brief.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

question.description: Question about this Brief’s clustered stories and cited sources.

dateKey.description: Archive day (YYYY-MM-DD). Followers / private owners only.

briefId.description: Specific Brief id. Followers / private owners only.

tools.name: clear_highlights
tools.description: Remove agent paint and notes. Restores the page.

tools.name: copy_share_link
tools.description: Return the canonical Topic URL to share. Read-only; does not send email.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: create_topic
tools.description: Create a private custom Topic via the API (paid plan + 1 credit). Queues the first Brief; poll get_topic_generation_status. Free / no-credit fail like the app. Confirms in-page. Does not fill the /topics/new form (that is start_create_topic).

name.description: Topic name (required). Same field as the Create Topic form.

whatToCover.description: Optional: what to cover. Description is generated from the first Brief.

voiceId.description: Optional podcast voice id. Defaults to the site default.

tools.name: explain_fiveminutebrief
tools.description: Explain FiveMinuteBrief (5m, Public, and Custom Topics) and return /public-topics, /plans, and /signup URLs.

tools.name: follow_public_topic
tools.description: Follow a 5m or Public Topic (uses a follow slot). Guests must start_login. Slot limits return PLAN_LIMIT. Confirms in-page.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: get_brief_newsletter
tools.description: Shareable copy plus canonical URL. Full copy when entitled (5m current day, follow, or private owner). Preview copy if you are not following a Public Topic.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

dateKey.description: Archive day (YYYY-MM-DD). Followers / private owners only; guests get current day.

briefId.description: Specific Brief id. Followers / private owners only.

tools.name: get_latest_brief
tools.description: Full Brief digest + URL. 5m: current day for everyone; pass dateKey only if you follow (archive). Public: full only while following — otherwise use get_public_topic_preview. Private custom: owner only. No brief.debug.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

dateKey.description: Archive day (YYYY-MM-DD). Followers / private owners only; guests get current day.

briefId.description: Specific Brief id. Followers / private owners only.

tools.name: get_podcast_episode
tools.description: Latest episode this viewer may hear: title, date, duration, listen URL, enclosure. 5m guests get ?variant=public (ad). Followers/owners get the private file. Not the archive.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: get_podcast_show
tools.description: Podcast RSS + per-app launch URLs (including Apple). 5m guests/non-followers (including admin who is not following): public ad show, no ?code=. Followers and private-Topic owners: private ad-free ?code= feed. Public Topic not followed: follow required (no code). Does not open an app (use open_podcast_app).

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: get_public_topic
tools.description: Topic metadata: description, cover, Brief/preview availability, archive + podcast access. Private Topics: owner only.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: get_public_topic_preview
tools.description: Preview a user-made Public Topic (not 5m): takeaway, top story titles, source count, follow CTA. Not the full Brief.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: get_topic_generation_status
tools.description: queued / generating / ready / failed / sparse for a Topic’s first Brief. Poll after create_topic. Sign-in required.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: highlight_brief_section
tools.description: Paint Top Stories, Quick Hits, What’s Next, or Today’s Take on the live Brief; dim other sections. Optional note. Preview viewers cannot paint What’s Next.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_coverage_note
tools.description: Light the sparse / special-single / expanding-coverage banner when explaining a thin day.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_plan_gate
tools.description: Outline credits, follow, or upgrade after create_topic / follow_public_topic was refused.

gate.description: Which refused control to point at.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_podcast_moment
tools.description: Jump the in-page player (script marker or estimate) and highlight the matching story when audio exists.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

story.description: Story id or title to highlight and seek toward.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_sources
tools.description: Glow publisher chips for a story (identity, not a URL dump). Preview: primary publisher of an on-screen story only.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

story.description: Story id or title. Defaults to the lead Top Story.

sourceUrls.description: Optional publisher names or source URLs. Defaults to that story’s sources.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_stories
tools.description: Outline 1–3 story cards by stable id (topChanges:0) or title. Dims siblings. Public preview: on-screen titles only. After pointing at a story, use highlight_sources for its publishers, then clear_highlights to restore the page.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

stories.description: 1–3 story ids or titles from get_latest_brief / preview.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: highlight_topic_card
tools.description: Scroll to and outline one Topic card on the catalog or dashboard (5m, follow CTA, or queued state).

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

note.description: Optional short note shown as a sticky chip on the page.

tools.name: list_my_topics
tools.description: Dashboard Topics you own or follow (private custom included): generation status and latest card take. Sign-in required.

tools.name: list_podcast_apps
tools.description: Podcast app buttons for a Topic (same set as Listen anywhere). Without topicId: the catalog of app ids. Private feeds: Apple, Overcast, Pocket Casts, Castro, Podcast Addict only.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: list_public_topics
tools.description: List 5m and Public Topics: name, id, topicKind, follower count, card take. When signed in: isFollowing and follow slots. No private Topics.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Fill the login form on this page. Does not submit credentials; the user must click Log in. Distinct from start_login, which only navigates here.

tools.name: open_plans
tools.description: Navigate this tab to /plans. Does not open Stripe checkout.

tools.name: open_podcast_app
tools.description: Open a Topic’s show in a podcast app (topicId + app id). Opens a new tab/deep link; does not replace the page. Guests cannot open a private feed.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

app.description: Podcast app id from list_podcast_apps (apple, spotify, overcast, …).

tools.name: retry_first_brief
tools.description: Re-enqueue first Brief (same credit/lock rules as topic-page Try again). Does not wait. Paid + credit. Confirms in-page.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.

tools.name: signup
tools.description: Fill the signup form on this page. Does not submit credentials; the user must click Create account. Distinct from start_signup, which only navigates here.

tools.name: start_login
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the login form. Does not fill or submit credentials. On /login the form is a separate declarative login tool.

tools.name: start_signup
tools.description: Navigate this tab to the signup form. Does not fill or submit credentials. On /signup the form is a separate declarative signup tool.

tools.name: unfollow_public_topic
tools.description: Unfollow a 5m or Public Topic. A Public Topic creator who unfollows gets preview only. Confirms in-page.

topicId.description: Topic id (e.g. topic:uuid). Defaults to the Topic on this page.
